results.title: CBI files FIR against Gensol, promoters for diverting IREDA loan funds
results.description: Anmol and Puneet Jaggi stepped down from the company as managing director and whole-time director, respectively, in May last year.

results.title: Rahul Gandhi backs tribal 'Satyagraha' against Ken-Betwa river-linking project
results.description: Rahul Gandhi has backed tribal protests against the Ken-Betwa river-linking project in Madhya Pradesh and promised to visit the site.
